Monochromatic green light is incident on a double slit and creates an interference pattern on a screen located at a distance a from the slits. The distance between the slits is d and the fringe spacing of the pattern is b.

What changes in d and the colour of the light will definitely cause the value of b to decrease?

d

Colour of light
A. Decreases Red
B. Increases Red
C. Increases Violet
D. Decreases Violet
